senses.gloss: Nala (see also Nara-rāja), n. of a nāga king: Māy 〔246.18〕.
Nalakūvara, n. of a yakṣa: Māy 〔94〕.

nala-ghātyā, reed-slaying (so Tib., literally, ḥdam bu bcom bzhin): hanmy eṣāṃ (gen. for acc.) nalaghātyayā MSV 〔i.177.13〕; ˚tyayā haniṣyanti 17. Just what form of killing is meant I do not know. The second member (not in Skt.) = Pali -ghaccā.
Nalamālin (= Pali Naḷamāli), n. of a mythical sea: Jm 〔92.9〕 (vs; ˚māly eṣa sāgaraḥ).

Nalinī (= Pali Naḷ˚, oftener Naḷinikā), n. of the heroine of the Nalinī Jātaka (colophon ˚nīye rājakumārīye jātakaṃ Mv 〔iii.152.19〕), a daughter of a king of Benares, who seduced Ekaśṛṅga: Mv 〔iii.146.4 ff.〕

Nālaka (= Pali id.), n. of a nephew and pupil of the ṛṣi Asita (also Nāla, and perhaps Nālada, q.v.; in LV called Naradatta; see also Nārada 3): Mv 〔ii.30.14〕; 〔33.14〕; 〔iii.382.14 ff.〕 (his story told at length); belonged to the Kātyāyana gotra, 〔382.13〕; 〔386.8〕; colophon, Nālakapraśnā (mss., Senart em. ˚naṃ) 〔389.12〕.

Nālanda, nt. (Pali Nālandā, also Nāla, Nālaka, Nālika), or ˚dā, n. of a village near (one-half yojana acc. to Mv) Rājagṛha, birthplace and family home of Śāriputra; also called Nālada acc. to Av 〔ii.186.6〕: rājagṛhasya ardhayojane nālanda-grāmakaṃ (v.l. nālandaṃ) nāma grāmaṃ Mv 〔iii.56.6〕; śrī-nālandā Mvy 〔4120〕.
Nālayu, m. or f., n. of a province (janapada; in the south): ˚yur nāma Gv 〔110.11〕; 〔111.6〕.

? nāli, m. or f. (˚liḥ, n. sg.), Mvy 〔7521〕, from the context should mean something connected with weaving; Tib. son pa, arrived(!) and so also Chin.!; Jap. pipe, or vein, which fits Skt. nāḍī (and Lex. nālī), but not the context in Mvy.
Nālī, n. of a yakṣiṇī: MSV 〔i.xviii.17〕.
Nālikera (= Pali Nāḷikera, ˚kīra), n. of a wicked king of Dantapura in Kaliṅga: Mv 〔iii.361.12〕 (text Nārīkela, v.l. nālikela); 〔368.14〕 (v.l. ˚la); 〔369.12〕 (v.l. ˚la).
nālīkera, nt. (cf. nāḍīkerī, and Skt. nālikera, nārīkela), cocoanut, the fruit of the cocoa-palm: Mv 〔ii.475.15〕 ˚rāṇi (v.l. ˚lāni).
